rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single profile before accessing account data. It retrieved the pending order sent to the DC address, confirmed the exact new shipping address, and only then updated it. For item modifications, the agent checked product variants, presented accurate available options, gathered the user’s specific selections, summarized the exact changes (including item IDs), and requested explicit confirmation. The agent initially proposed using the gift card for any price difference, but when the user requested PayPal, it updated the plan, asked for confirmation, and executed the changes with the PayPal method. Tool results show correct item replacements, correct recalculated difference charged to PayPal, and updated order status. Final messages accurately reflect the tool outputs. No policy violations: authenticated user, proper confirmations before writes, correct actions on the right account, and no fabricated information.
